title: Ruby | Fringed Cape Poncho With Flowing Sleeves
bodyHtml:
Meet the piece that turns a simple pair of jeans into an outfit worthy of a second look. This fringe poncho drapes loosely over the body with wide cape sleeves and a natural fall that skims rather than clings, while the tassel trim adds movement with every step. Slip it on for a market morning, a country weekend, or a casual lunch with friends, and feel effortlessly put-together without even trying. It's the kind of layer that makes getting dressed feel easy again.

Why you'll love it

  • The oversized silhouette is loose and unstructured, flattering on every body shape
  • A relaxed round neckline makes it an easy slip-on, no fuss required
  • Full-length fringe along the hem brings playful movement to a laid-back look
  • Doesn't cling anywhere, giving you all-day comfort from morning to evening
  • A genuine hard-to-find piece with a western-bohemian edge you won't see everywhere
  • Wide cape sleeves drape beautifully, whether worn alone or over a simple top
  • Versatile enough for country walks, city outings, or weekend travel
